label: agent
scenario: Restaurant AI reservation assistant books a party, reads out a confirmation code and sends SMS confirmation.
task: Book a table for six this Saturday around 8 PM for Leah Morgan at Saffron Table.

outcome.confirmation_artifact: confirmation code ST482; SMS confirmation sent to 555-0126

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: thank you for calling Saffron Table. this is the Saffron Table reservation assistant. are you looking to make a new reservation, or change an existing one?

turns.speaker: bot
turns.text: hi, I'm an AI assistant calling on behalf of Leah Morgan. I'd like to make a new reservation for six people this Saturday at eight PM.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: sure, I can help with that. let me check availability for a party of six this Saturday, September nineteenth, at eight PM.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I don't have eight PM for six, but I do have seven fifteen or eight forty five. would either of those work?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: perfect. can I get a name and a mobile number for the reservation?

turns.speaker: bot
turns.text: Leah Morgan, and the number is 555-0126.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: thank you, Leah. I've reserved a table for six on Saturday, September nineteenth, at eight forty five PM. your confirmation code is S T 4 8 2. I've also sent a text confirmation to 555-0126. please note we hold tables for fifteen minutes.

turns.speaker: bot
turns.text: thanks. could you repeat the confirmation code?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: of course. it's S as in Sam, T as in Tom, four, eight, two.

turns.speaker: bot
turns.text: got it, S T 4 8 2. thank you.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: you're welcome. we look forward to seeing you Saturday.
